title: Witch's Potion (miniquest)
start: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington, south of Falador and west of Port Sarim.

steps.t: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington, west of the Port Sarim lodestone and south of Falador. [Chat: 3 I'm looking for work. › Accept]
Kill a rat for a rat's tail.

sub.t: Some rats can be found in Brian's Archery Supplies.

get_inside.text: Rimmington town centre is marked by a well, and the house portal is just to the north.
pic: Rimmington town centre is marked by a well, and the house portal is just to the north.

get_inside.text: Walk west from the Port Sarim lodestone or south from Falador.
Use the explorer's ring 3 or 4 to teleport to the cabbage patch and walk south-west to get to Rimmington, but this takes longer.
Use Remora's necklace from the Song from the Depths quest to teleport to the entrance of the Grotworm Lair.
House Teleport and exit at Rimmington.

If the Love Story quest has been completed, members can use a Rimmington tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Rimmington house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
Teleport to the Crafting Guild with a skills necklace and then walk south-east.
Use one of the free teleports of the Nature's sentinel outfit to teleport to the Elder trees up north.
Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south.
